summary: Usage reports skip historical-only execution series

replay.detail: Existing claims and cumulative usage remain authoritative; no observations are rewritten or discarded.

schema.detail: Adds a rebuildable usage-reporting timestamp index during store initialization.

rules.detail: Usage still subtracts the canonical baseline for each reporting boundary and retains unreplicated readings.

compatibility.detail: Request and response formats are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No coordinated fleet operation is required.

recovery.detail: Indexes are recreated from existing authoritative rows on store initialization.
